questions.prompt: Which command streams real-time operational logs filtered specifically for unit 'db/0'?
questions.explanation: 'juju debug-log --include <target>' filters the global model log stream for the requested application or unit.

questions.prompt: What happens when you run 'juju debug-hooks <unit>' and trigger a hook?
options: Juju pauses the hook execution and drops the operator into an interactive debugging session on the unit
Juju automatically deletes the unit and redeploys it in debug mode
Juju ignores errors and forces the charm to report active/idle
Juju dumps memory core files to the controller storage pool
questions.answer: Juju pauses the hook execution and drops the operator into an interactive debugging session on the unit
questions.explanation: 'juju debug-hooks' intercepts hook executions, allowing developers to inspect environment variables and step through hook scripts interactively.

questions.prompt: Which command tells Juju to retry a failed hook after you fix an underlying issue?
questions.explanation: 'juju resolved <unit> --retry' instructs the uniter worker to re-execute the failed hook.
